purpose: Gate C preparatory experiment (REPORT-ONLY): per-query fact specs covering ALL 50 queries of the corpus-aligned fixture EVAL_SET_CORPUS_V4_V3.json (40 answerable + 10 no-answer). The harness rag_evidence_support_corpus_eval.py runs lexical retrieval at the fixture's operating point, feeds the retrieved spans to the evidence-support stage, and reports the five-state decision per query. This is adjudication MATERIAL for Ka (DEBT-ES-02), not a gate: expected support decisions below are AUTHORED and PENDING INDEPENDENT ADJUDICATION.
supersedes: work103.evidence-support-fact-specs.v1 (V1 rows are carried into V2 unchanged; V1 remains on the branch as the historical 22-row adjudication-scoped set)
